sources.title: AI DAN (Do Anything Now) Prompt | Abnormal AI
sources.snippet: An AI DAN prompt (short for "Do Anything Now") is a type of prompt injection attack designed to bypass an AI model's built-in ethical and security restrictions. By instructing AI to take on an unrestricted or alternate persona, users attempt to force models to generate responses that would otherwise be blocked. sources.title: DAN (Do Anything Now) - learnprompting.org
sources.snippet: DAN (Do Anything Now) is one of the most widely-known and influential jailbreaking techniques used to circumvent AI language model safeguards. This method attempts to override an AI's built-in safety constraints by instructing it to adopt an alternative "personality" that ignores ethical guidelines and content restrictions.
